notes_for_editor: Three sites agree the crow's nest and camp date to the 1920s and were in ruins in the 1980s. Nothing read describes the site today, and no photo from after the ruins was found. The only current-state statement is the hike-in tag. Idaho Fire Lookouts says it has no documented staffing history, so the story leaves staffing out. The brief's kind 'platform' is not contradicted, but no source calls it a platform. Record us-id-big-meadows-2 (Kaniksu NF, 47.9895 -116.2031) cites the same Forest Lookouts page used here, whose listing is Bonner County at 59N-5W-33, so that record is probably a duplicate with wrong coordinates; flag for merge. Photo already on the record (idahofirelookouts.com 2025 upload) was not re-added.
